dedupe_keys.name: intangible benefits of nature based solutions for wastewater treatment

description: The research compilation joins ecosystem-service and literature estimates of non-market wastewater-treatment benefits, with locations, valuation methods, original values and amounts converted to 2023 New Zealand dollars. This resource is provided by Wei Yang. Coverage is global as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Benefit transfer requires attention to study methods and context; these are valuation estimates, not direct engineering measurements. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-iwa-benchmark-simulation-models. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
